# ledger_manual_payments (Data Source)

Lists the manual payments of one occurrence, ordered by `paid_on` and then identifier. Every page is read. Records that a confirmed bank match now stands in for are listed with `replaced_by_match_id` set. Amounts are exact decimal strings and are never summed or converted here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The payments recorded by hand for one occurrence. Amounts are exact decimal strings and are never summed or converted.
data "ledger_manual_payments" "march_rent" {
  occurrence_id = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA"
}

output "march_rent_payments" {
  value = [for p in data.ledger_manual_payments.march_rent.items : "undefined undefined on undefined"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence to list the payments of.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The recorded payments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) The amount paid, an exact decimal string with its original scale.
- `created_at` (String) When it was recorded (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `currency` (String) The ISO 4217 currency code of amount.
- `id` (String) The identifier of the payment record (a ULID).
- `note` (String) The free-text note, or null.
- `occurrence_id` (String) The occurrence the payment is for.
- `paid_on` (String) The day the payment was made, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `replaced_by_match_id` (String) The confirmed bank payment match that now stands in for this record (it is then kept but does not count), or null.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version of the record.
